prerequisites.rationale_text: Must decompose before you can trace to root. RCA depends on breaking the problem into logical parts (disaggregation, logic trees) before tracing causal chains to the root cause. Without decomposition, the analyst faces an undifferentiated mass of symptoms.
prerequisites.source_quote: Any problem of real consequence is too complicated to solve without breaking it down into logical parts. Logic trees serve as a graphical tool to break a problem down and organize analysis.

curation_notes.summary: Structural dependency. RCA's key frameworks (Five Whys, Fishbone diagrams, logic trees) all presuppose that the problem has first been decomposed into components.
